versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support the continuous timing requirement analysis Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR shall support observation, assessment and methodology of timing requirements throughout the development cycle. Rationale: Application Software has specific timing requirements which have to follow the common methodology in order to provide reliable and comparable information towards timing. Use Case: Real time control of today's gasoline injection system. Appli es to: AP, CP Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
